homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: all nine cards are about the Index. 'Provenance Index' in the archive is #127's blog post, the archive-wide attribution anchor of the Mind Control Poems blog, a distinct entity sharing the name (string-pass candidates D0001–D0007, rejected). 'Getty' in the registry is also Getty Images, a different company from the J. Paul Getty Trust. 'GPI' does not occur in the archive's texts. The Getty's own initiative page gives one name to two things, 'an active research initiative carried out by Getty staff' and 'an evolving data resource with the same name' (F31), and by 2004 to a department (F36): senses of the one entity on its own pages, composed as such, not homonyms.

captures.description: THE GETTY PROVENANCE INDEX, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'an open-access digital database maintained by the Getty Research Institute that provides over 12 million records tracking the ownership, circulation, display, and transfer of artworks.' Scope (12 million linked open data records on the Arches platform; archival inventories, auction catalogues and dealer stock books; the Knoedler and Goupil stock books; sales catalogues from roughly the sixteenth to the twentieth century), searchable categories, and the search portal. An image strip ('View all') heads the paste. Nine cards: three Getty pages, Princeton's guide to the legacy database, the GitHub CSV exports, CNI, USC Libraries, ARIAH (the relaunch), Smarthistory.
